After many years at this practice, I finally switched to a new GP with better reviews, and I honestly regret not doing it sooner.

During my time at this practice, I was almost always seen by a different doctor at each appointment, which made it very difficult to build continuity of care. Unfortunately, I often felt that my concerns were not properly listened to. I was eventually referred with the wrong diagnosis and ended up having surgery after four years with the specialist I had been referred to.

After the surgery, my condition returned and the pain became even worse than before, with infections occurring more frequently. I was repeatedly prescribed different antibiotics, but the underlying cause was never properly investigated. When I moved to my new GP, I essentially had to start the process again because my previous concerns had not been fully explored.

I also remember trying to explain my symptoms during one appointment with Dr Anita Ghosh and asking if certain blood tests could be repeated.
